subLevels.content: Learn common phrases used when meeting someone for the first time. Focus on polite openers and culturally appropriate body language cues.
aiPrompts: How would you greet a stranger at a bus stop?
Practice introducing yourself to a new classmate.
Role-play: You meet your neighbor for the first time.
What cultural differences exist in greeting strangers?

subLevels.content: Master time-specific greetings such as 'Good morning', 'Good afternoon', and 'Good evening' across formal and informal registers.
aiPrompts: Greet your coworker when arriving at the office in the morning.
How do you say goodbye to a friend after a late dinner?
Practice switching between formal and casual morning greetings.
Role-play: Greet your teacher at the start of class.

subLevels.content: Go beyond 'How are you?' to learn natural follow-up phrases and responses that show genuine interest in a conversation partner.
aiPrompts: Ask a friend how their weekend was using casual language.
Role-play: You meet a colleague who looks tired — ask with empathy.
Practice three different ways to respond to 'How are you?'
How would you check on someone who has been sick?

subLevels.content: Build a confident self-introduction covering your name, origin, hobbies, and reason for learning the language.
aiPrompts: Introduce yourself at a language exchange meetup.
Role-play: You are at a job interview — give a 30-second self-introduction.
Practice introducing yourself and asking the other person about their hobbies.
Create a short self-introduction for an online learning community.

subLevels.content: Learn how to introduce two people to each other in social and professional settings, including polite phrasing and context clues.
aiPrompts: Introduce your best friend to your parents at a family dinner.
Role-play: Introduce a new team member during a work meeting.
Practice introducing two friends who share a common hobby.
How would you introduce a guest speaker at a school event?

subLevels.content: Explore various ways to end a conversation gracefully — from casual 'See you later!' to formal farewells and well-wishes.
aiPrompts: Say goodbye to a friend you will see again tomorrow.
Role-play: End a phone call with a business partner politely.
Practice saying goodbye at the end of a language class.
How do you wish someone well before they go on a long trip?
